bullets: Image Preprocessing Pipeline: Image normalization, resizing, and illumination correction (OpenCV / PIL) - Standardizes input produce images to uniform resolution and color balance
Feature Extraction Engine: Handcrafted visual descriptor computation (Color Histograms & GLCM) (scikit-image / NumPy) - Extracts color distributions (RGB/HSV) and texture irregularity measures
KNN Classification Engine: Instance-based distance calculation and majority-vote prediction (scikit-learn) - Computes Euclidean distances to training vectors and assigns freshness category
Dataset Management Subsystem: Dataset ingestion, label encoding, and train/test partition (pandas / File System) - Maintains annotated produce image corpus across freshness stages
Performance Evaluation Module: Model metrics and validation matrix calculation (scikit-learn.metrics) - Evaluates accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix
